video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows how an ETL pipeline (extract, transform, load) turns a bakery's messy sales files into one table and a dashboard

file_tumble.what: Each of the three source file cards drops onto the shelf, fading in and straightening from a slight tilt

hook_path_draw.what: A dotted violet route draws itself from the files along a zigzag to the dashboard card

hook_path_exit.what: The dotted violet route fades away for good

dashboard_hook_enter.what: The dashboard card fades into view at the end of the dotted route

hook_bars_grow.what: The dashboard's three bars grow upward from the baseline, appearing for the first time

dashboard_hook_exit.what: The dashboard card fades out and leaves the screen

camera_push_shelf.what: The camera moves in from the whole scene to the shelf of files

shopfront_enter.what: A small bakery shopfront fades in and rises into place beside the shelf

shopfront_exit.what: The bakery shopfront fades out as the camera leaves the shelf

file_tag_enter.what: A name tag fades in and rises onto each file, one file after another

file_tag_exit.what: The name tags fade out and disappear

date_outline_enter.what: Dashed navy outlines and a not-equal badge fade in around two date cells written in different styles

repeat_bracket_enter.what: A navy bracket and a tag fade in beside two identical rows

missing_flag_enter.what: A navy question-mark flag fades in and grows slightly over an empty price cell

problems_exit.what: The three problem marks fade out and disappear

camera_pull_back.what: The camera pulls back from the shelf to show the whole zigzag line

belt_draw.what: The navy conveyor belt draws itself out of the edge of the shelf and down the frame in three runs

rollers_enter.what: The purple rollers under the belt fade into view

rollers_spin.what: The rollers under the belt keep turning at a constant speed

belt_tread.what: Small tread marks slide along the belt at a constant speed, always in the same direction

chevrons_enter.what: Violet direction chevrons fade into view along the belt

chevrons_travel.what: Violet chevrons travel along the belt at a steady speed to show its direction

chevrons_exit.what: The violet chevrons fade out and disappear

station_rise.what: Each station frame and its numbered badge fades in and rises onto the belt, one after another

table_rise.what: The empty table fades in and rises into place at the end of the belt

camera_to_extract.what: The camera moves in from the whole line to the files and the funnel

extract_paths_draw.what: A violet path draws itself from each file to the top of the funnel

copy_fly.what: A copy of a row, already visible on its file, glides along a curved path to the top of the funnel and shrinks

copy_drop.what: The copied row moves down through the funnel onto the tray and returns to full size

camera_to_funnel.what: The camera pans and zooms to follow the copied rows to the funnel and the tray

tray_enter.what: A navy tray fades into view on the belt under the funnel

extract_paths_exit.what: The violet paths from the files fade out and disappear

tray_travel.what: The tray of rows, already on the belt, rides along it to the next station

camera_follow.what: The camera pans to keep the moving tray in view from one station to the next

repeat_cross_draw.what: A bold navy cross draws itself over the repeated row

repeat_tip_off.what: The repeated row tips off the belt, falls into the bin and does not come back

missing_flag_pop.what: A navy question-mark flag fades in over the row with no price

missing_slide_aside.what: The row with no price, already visible, slides from the tray to a side shelf

check_label_enter.what: The label under the side shelf fades into view

check_label_exit.what: The label under the side shelf fades out

rows_settle.what: The remaining rows on the tray slide down to close the gaps

date_flip.what: Each date cell squashes flat and opens again showing the same date in one shared style

press_down.what: The press plate, already visible, moves down onto the stack of rows

press_up.what: The press plate moves back up to its resting position

row_shape.what: Under the press each row card widens to the same width and its outline changes from navy to violet

column_labels_enter.what: Three column names fade into view on the press

column_labels_exit.what: The column names on the press fade out

arm_place_row.what: The stacking arm carries a row, already visible on the tray, across into its place in the table

arm_return.what: The stacking arm swings back from the table to the tray for the next row

tray_exit.what: The empty tray fades out and disappears

camera_pull_back_recap.what: The camera pulls back from the table to show the whole line

badge_pulse.what: A numbered station badge swells slightly with a glow and returns to normal as the narrator names it

letter_lift.what: A large violet letter fades in and rises beside a station badge

letters_gather.what: The three violet letters, already visible, glide together and grow into the word ETL

etl_exit.what: The word ETL fades out and disappears

camera_to_dashboard.what: The camera moves in from the whole line to the table and the dashboard

dashboard_rise.what: The dashboard card fades in and rises into place on top of the table

connector_draw.what: A violet connector line draws itself from the table up to the dashboard

row_pulse.what: A stored table row brightens with a violet glow and returns to normal

bar_grow.what: A bar appears on the dashboard and grows upward from the baseline when its table row lights up

total_count.what: The total number on the dashboard counts upward together with the growing bars

camera_pull_back_night.what: The camera pulls back from the dashboard to show the whole line

clock_enter.what: A clock badge fades in and rises into place above the shelf

clock_to_night.what: The hands of the clock sweep round and its face darkens from white to navy

new_file_drop.what: A new file card drops onto the shelf, fading in and straightening

night_tray_enter.what: A fresh tray of rows fades into view on the belt

night_tray_run.what: The fresh tray, already on the belt, rides the whole line through all three stations

night_rows_place.what: The new rows move from the tray into the next free places in the table

night_tray_exit.what: The fresh tray, now empty, fades out and disappears

night_bars_rise.what: The dashboard bars grow a little taller after the new rows land

rule_badge_enter.what: A badge with a short sentence fades in and rises into place beside the belt

world_exit.what: The whole conveyor scene fades out for good

camera_push_outro.what: The camera moves in toward the dashboard while the scene fades

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward into view one after another, left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens behind the finished logo and settles to a fainter glow

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises into place

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises into place

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow inside the button slides a few pixels to the right once

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind an invisible edge

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out at the end of its scene

subtitle_words.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as the narrator says them
